summary.name: Zed
summary.one_liner: Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter, and the page also promotes a multiplayer environment for coding with agents powered by DeltaDB.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Zed as a multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter. It also presents a multiplayer environment for coding with agents, powered by a product called DeltaDB. The page lists related projects: a client that connects to any agent, GPUI (a GPU-accelerated UI framework for Rust), and Tree-sitter (incremental parsing for programming languages). The rest of the page text is a list of development tasks and a sample engineering write-up about caching SumTree summaries, which appears to be content shown on the page rather than product documentation.
notable: Multiplayer collaborative editing from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter
Built on GPUI, a GPU-accelerated Rust UI framework
Positioned as an environment for coding with agents, powered by DeltaDB
caveats: Pricing and full platform support are not stated on the page; the Mac listings are from third-party awesome lists
Page is mostly marketing copy with few concrete product details
